challenge.reason: The DoD includes capability beyond the PRD's declared goals. Only the first DoD item (--dry-run exits 0/1 on the floor decision without merging) serves the inspection goal. The second and third items add a persisted per-PR history log at .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl, appended on every evaluation, and an --explain timeline with --since filtering and --format json|table output. The first PRD goal limits inspection to the current decision and says 'Historical storage and query features are outside this PRD'. The history log is historical storage and --explain/--since/--format are query features, so these DoD items are named exclusions, not a natural extension. The Phase-1 claim that they stay in scope because they relate to inspection ignores that exclusion. This is over-scope (DoD capability not a subset of declared goals), not under-citation: no declared PRD goal covers the extra items. Fix: cut the PRDR to the --dry-run flag alone; history and explain need their own PRD.
